P_0x008A4B.en: An artificial intelligence researcher, and the developer of "AI-0," a high-performance combat AI. She once served as an instructor at the Federation Army officers' academy, where Aqua Centrum was one of her students.

P_0x008B5F.en: Goes by Josh. Son of Felio Radcliff, a Re-Technologist who studies the mysterious ruins discovered in Antarctica. He has a stepsister named Cliana Rimskaya. Not especially personable, and calm by nature, but he shows an emotional side at times.

P_0x008CD4.en: Joshua Radcliff's stepsister. She was excavated from the Antarctic ruins and restored by the Re-Technologists using the system "Sympatheia." Long-term experiments with it caused her to split into two personalities (Chris and Riana). Each is aware of the other and they can converse with one another. Riana is strong-willed and somewhat dry in personality.

P_0x008EBC.en: Joshua Radcliff's stepsister. She was excavated from the Antarctic ruins and restored by the Re-Technologists using the system "Sympatheia." Long-term experiments with it caused her to split into two personalities (Chris and Riana). Each is aware of the other and they can converse with one another. Chris is reserved and quiet by nature.

P_0x009095.en: One of Ruina's pseudo-life forms, the Meliorexe. To revive the "King of Ruin," she requires waves of negative emotion, and pilots the Fortis Ala in repeated acts of destruction and slaughter. Calm and collected, she shows no mercy to those who defy her.

P_0x009F48.en: A boy who escaped the sealed <Aidoneus Island>. Quiet, few words. Shows rare talent piloting mobile weapons. His past is a mystery.

P_0x00A244.en: RCommander of "GS," the Gaia Sabers, under the <Earth Fed Gov't> President. Near the <Inspector Incident> she approached Graien Grusman via Nibhal Mubhal, earning special aide. Cold, ambitious.

P_0x00A3C2.en: &A Gaia Sabers scientist. Once studied <Aerogater> materials at <DC>, then used the data to develop metal cells called <Machine Cell>. Also developed the <Geim System>.
